notes.title: Important server update
notes.content:
- New shop items : skins and character stat reset (work in progress)
- Bug fix : Crash if a hit have too much Damages
- Bug fix : toxic puddle cannot be casted on party member anymore
- Fire ball balancing : damage bonus have been decreased
- Bug fix : King Eye drop weapons as it was supposed to do
- Weapon enhancement : number of dragon eyes required is increased with weapon lvl
- XP pot balancing : XP has been reduced
- Boss balancing : King Eye and King Wurm are quicker to return on their spawn spot to regen.
- New feature : Arena tournament mode has been integrated (an announcement will be done tomorrow). 
- Bug fix : avatar issue on HD screen 

New map release has been postponed to next month in order to fix important bugs first and balance game play.
